milestones.goal: J1 end to end on a local chain: seed, run month 4 release, 47 paid and 3 held on S1; backup take recorded

Deliverables, QA on the judged path, final take, submission

tasks.title: Scaffold the two packages and make the first commit
tasks.objective: contracts/ (Hardhat 3, viem toolbox, OpenZeppelin) and web/ (Next.js 16, Tailwind 4) compile and run; root README states the first-commit sentence; first commit after the window start
acceptance: WHEN `npx hardhat compile` runs in contracts THE SYSTEM SHALL compile an empty project without error
WHEN `npm run build` runs in web THE SYSTEM SHALL build the scaffold
tasks.rollback: delete the folders; nothing is deployed

tasks.title: OpenTally contracts with tests (RED first)
tasks.objective: TestUSD, OpenTally (sites, connections, EIP-712 summaries, rule, holds, release, events) and OpenTallyFactory pass the acceptance tests
tasks.rollback: git revert the T02 commit; nothing deployed

tasks.title: Seed generator, local deploy script and chain state API
tasks.objective: a deterministic seed (3 sites, 50 connections, months 1 to 4, 3 planted faults) deploys and seeds an instance on the local Hardhat node; web reads it through /api/state
acceptance: WHEN the seed runs against a fresh local node THE SYSTEM SHALL register 3 sites and 50 connections, deposit 17,500 tUSD and submit months 1 to 3
WHEN /api/state is called THE SYSTEM SHALL return the figures, sites, connections and holds read from the chain

tasks.title: Run pipeline as a server-sent event stream, with the screen
tasks.objective: POST /api/run signs month 4 summaries, submits them, screens traces (clone, flat, outlier) and holds through the verifier key, waits for the window, releases, streaming five named steps; a run lock and rate limit
acceptance: WHEN /api/run is called on the seeded local instance THE SYSTEM SHALL stream five steps and end with a release of 47 connections and 3 holds

tasks.title: S1 golden path, ugly is fine
tasks.objective: the tally page shows the figures, the ledger, the button; pressing it streams the steps and ends with lit cells, the balance counting down and the receipt row; tokens and fonts from UI-SPEC
verify: cd web && npm run e2e -- run.spec
tasks.notes: Plan changed 2026-10-19: also touched the chain reader and state shaping (the first screen showed month 4 as pending before its summaries existed; it now shows month 3), the pipeline (step 1 kept the wrong-key note only while running), the limiter (DEMO_LIMITS=off for tests) and next.config.ts (cacheComponents off: it forbids route runtime and dynamic exports).

tasks.title: Backup take of J1 on the local build
tasks.objective: a screen recording of the full demo script on the local chain, kept outside the repository, so a working take exists before Sepolia
acceptance: WHEN the take is reviewed THE SYSTEM SHALL show the first screen, the five steps, the lit cells and the receipt within 3 minutes
verify: observe: backup take recorded at ../hackathon-idea/ieee-climatechain-2026/takes/backup-local.webm with the five steps and the receipt visible
tasks.notes: Recorded with Playwright video capture through web/e2e/take.spec.ts, which runs only when TAKE_OUT is set; the file itself stays outside the repository.

tasks.title: Fresh programme per visitor
tasks.objective: the first screen opens on the newest unreleased programme instance; a run pins its instance in the URL (?programme=); after a release a spare instance is seeded in the background; the newest released instance is linked as the last visitor's release; fresh runs pause with a plain message when the demo wallet is low; chains: local, Sepolia and Base Sepolia from one config
acceptance: WHEN a visitor opens / and an unreleased instance exists THE SYSTEM SHALL show the newest unreleased instance with 0 of 50 paid
WHEN a run starts THE SYSTEM SHALL pin the instance in the URL so a reload shows that run's result
WHEN a release completes THE SYSTEM SHALL seed a spare instance so the next visitor opens a fresh programme
IF the demo wallet cannot pay for a run THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL refuse the run with 'Fresh runs are paused: the demo wallet is low on test ETH' and show the last release
verify: cd web && npm run e2e -- visitors.spec
tasks.notes: Added 2026-10-19: on a shared demo the first judge's run would leave every later judge on a released programme.

tasks.title: Deploy to Sepolia and Vercel; verify source
tasks.objective: token, factory and a seeded instance on Sepolia with verified source; the web app on Vercel reading them; deployment.json committed
acceptance: WHEN the deployed URL opens signed out THE SYSTEM SHALL show S1 with the figures read from Sepolia
WHEN the instance address is opened on the explorer THE SYSTEM SHALL show verified source
verify: observe: verified source on the Sepolia explorer for OpenTally, OpenTallyFactory and TestUSD
tasks.rollback: redeploy the previous Vercel deployment; a bad instance is replaced through the factory
tasks.notes: blocked on Sepolia test ETH in the deployer wallet (A-4)

tasks.title: S1 to the UI spec: tiers, states, motion, record mode
tasks.objective: S1 matches the treatment table and the mockup: the payoff in site order, NumberFlow figures, the receipt row, the step list that collapses, the rule strip with the chosen token, the how-to-judge card, ?state= for first-run, running, released, partial, error; ?record=1; ?judge=0; Alt+Shift+R
acceptance: WHEN ?state=error opens THE SYSTEM SHALL show the failed step with its reason and the Retry release button with every cell in its prior state
verify: cd web && npm run e2e -- states.spec
tasks.notes: NumberFlow dropped: the figures already count down one grant at a time in step with the lighting cells, which is the moving number the spec asked for; one fewer dependency. ?state= previews carry an on-screen preview banner.

tasks.title: S2 connection view, S3 rule and keys, S4 about
tasks.objective: S2 with the trace against the cohort, the hold reason, Lift hold and Keep hold through /api/hold; S3 with the quoted rule, parameters, key table and contract links; S4 with the copy block
verify: cd web && npm run e2e -- hold.spec
tasks.notes: Added a release route for connections made eligible by a lifted hold, so the lift visibly pays (48 of 50).

tasks.title: Re-sum drawer with downloads
tasks.objective: the drawer rebuilds the paid count and amount from Released events, compares with the chain's counters, and downloads JSON and CSV
verify: cd web && npm run e2e -- resum.spec
tasks.notes: The browser reads the Released events and counters straight from a public RPC and adds them up itself; the server route is only a fallback.

tasks.title: Security gate and the wrong-key moment
tasks.objective: step 1 of the run shows one summary rejected for the wrong site key and re-signed; secrets scan; rate limits verified; headers; the security document's threat model drafted from the code
acceptance: WHEN the client bundle is searched THE SYSTEM SHALL contain no private key or RPC secret
verify: cd web && npm run build && ! grep -rE '0x[0-9a-fA-F]{64}' .next/static
